Button radius 1.$description: Corner radius for Large and Icon Large (11px = radius/xl)

Button radius 2.$description: Corner radius for Small, Default, Icon Small, Icon Default (8px = radius/base)

Button spacing.$description: Gap between icon and label — all sizes (4px)

Button-padding-default.$description: Horizontal padding for Default and Large (12px) — En UI control padding

Button-padding-xsmall.$description: Horizontal padding for XSmall button (8px) — En UI control/xs

bg.$description: Tooltip background — aliases color/background/inverted (zinc/900, a dark bubble).

fg.$description: Tooltip text — aliases color/background/inverted/foreground (white on the dark bubble).

bg.$description:
Intent:      Fill of a selectable Item row on hover
Use when:    Item with onSelect, pointer over it, not selected
Do not use:  Selected rows — use item/selected/bg; static (non-selectable) rows
Use instead: item/selected/bg for the selected row
Note:        Added 2026-09-22; same blues as the sidebar's selected item so selection looks the same across the app.
Status:      active

Intent:      Fill of the selected Item row in a single-select list (master–detail)
Use when:    The one Item with selected=true; always with item/selected/border
Do not use:  Hover — use item/hover/bg; multi-select checkmarks; the sidebar — use color/sidebar/active
Use instead: item/hover/bg for hover
Note:        Added 2026-09-22; same blues as the sidebar's selected item so selection looks the same across the app.
Status:      active

border.$description:
Intent:      1px inset border of the selected Item row
Use when:    Always together with item/selected/bg
Do not use:  Unselected rows; focus rings — use color/border/focus
Use instead: color/border/default for Variant=Outline rows
Note:        Added 2026-09-22; same blues as the sidebar's selected item so selection looks the same across the app.
Status:      active

fg.$description:
Intent:      Title text on the selected Item row
Use when:    Title of the row with selected=true
Do not use:  Description text — keeps color/surface/muted/foreground
Use instead: color/surface/default/foreground on unselected rows
Note:        Added 2026-09-22; same blues as the sidebar's selected item so selection looks the same across the app.
Status:      active

surface.$description:
Intent:      Gradient surface of the numbered shield marker in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Filling the shield marker rendered by CareerPathStep
Do not use:  Other steppers, badges, achievements, cards or decorative shapes
Use instead: color/surface/tint for generic brand-tinted component surfaces
Foreground:  career-stepper/foreground
Status:      active

border.$description:
Intent:      Persistent boundary of the shield marker in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Drawing the inset edge around the CareerPathStep number shield
Do not use:  Focus rings, selected states, row borders or any component outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: color/border/focus for focus, color/border/default for general component borders
Status:      active

foreground.$description:
Intent:      Number text inside the shield marker in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Rendering the visible sequence number inside CareerPathStep
Do not use:  Step titles, descriptions, icons or text outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: career-stepper/row-foreground for step titles, career-stepper/description for supporting text
Status:      active

connector.$description:
Intent:      Structural line connecting adjacent markers in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Drawing the vertical rail between CareerPathStep markers, except after the final step
Do not use:  Dividers, borders, timelines or steppers outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: color/border/default for general dividers and structural lines
Status:      active

row-surface.$description:
Intent:      Flat surface behind one content row in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Filling the position-and-level row rendered by CareerPathStep
Do not use:  General cards, list items or rows outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: color/surface/default for generic flat component surfaces
Foreground:  career-stepper/row-foreground
Status:      active

row-border.$description:
Intent:      Frame border around one content row in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Outlining the position-and-level row rendered by CareerPathStep
Do not use:  The shield marker, focus states or containers outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: career-stepper/border for the shield marker, color/border/default for general component frames
Status:      active

row-foreground.$description:
Intent:      Primary title text inside a Career Path Stepper row
Use when:    Rendering the position, level and level-name title in CareerPathStep
Do not use:  Marker numbers, supporting descriptions or text outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: career-stepper/foreground for marker numbers, career-stepper/description for supporting text
Status:      active

description.$description:
Intent:      Supporting readiness text inside a Career Path Stepper row
Use when:    Rendering expectation counts or secondary context beneath a CareerPathStep title
Do not use:  Primary titles, marker numbers or supporting text outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: career-stepper/row-foreground for titles, color/text/secondary for general supporting text
Status:      active

radius.$description:
Intent:      Corner radius of the content row in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Rounding the bordered row rendered by CareerPathStep
Do not use:  The clipped shield marker or containers outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: radius/surface for generic component surfaces
Status:      active

step-gap.$description:
Intent:      Horizontal separation between the marker rail and content row in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Laying out the shield-and-connector column beside CareerPathStep content
Do not use:  Internal row spacing or layouts outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: spacing/component/md for general component-internal spacing
Status:      active

row-gap.$description:
Intent:      Internal separation between main content and trailing actions in a Career Path Stepper row
Use when:    CareerPathStep includes controls in its actions slot
Do not use:  The leading drag-handle gap, marker-to-row spacing or components outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: spacing/component/xs for the leading handle gap, career-stepper/step-gap for marker-to-row spacing
Status:      active

row-padding.$description:
Intent:      Internal inset around content in a Career Path Stepper row
Use when:    Padding the bordered row rendered by CareerPathStep
Do not use:  Marker insets, page layout or containers outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: spacing/component/md for generic component padding
Status:      active

item-gap.$description:
Intent:      Vertical separation after each row in Career Path Stepper
Use when:    Spacing consecutive CareerPathStep rows while leaving room for the connector rail
Do not use:  General list spacing, row padding or layouts outside Career Path Stepper
Use instead: spacing/layout/xs for general gaps between adjacent components
Status:      active

bg.$description:
Intent:      Fill of a user message block in the chat panel
Use when:    User turns in the AI chat
Do not use:  Assistant turns (no fill); other chat UIs
Use instead: chat/assistant/fg on the panel for assistant text
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

fg.$description:
Intent:      Text of a user message
Use when:    On chat/user/bg only
Do not use:  Elsewhere
Use instead: color/background/default/foreground
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

border.$description:
Intent:      1px border of a user message block
Use when:    Always with chat/user/bg
Do not use:  Focus or selection
Use instead: color/border/focus for focus
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

fg.$description:
Intent:      Assistant message text — plain, no bubble
Use when:    Assistant turns
Do not use:  User turns
Use instead: chat/user/fg
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

bg.$description:
Intent:      Fill of code blocks inside chat messages
Use when:    Code / JSON in assistant replies
Do not use:  Inline highlights
Use instead: color/surface/muted for inline code
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

Intent:      Fill of the chat composer (text box + toolbar)
Use when:    The PromptInput container
Do not use:  Other inputs — use input/bg directly
Use instead: color/input/bg
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

border.$description:
Intent:      Border of the chat composer
Use when:    PromptInput container at rest
Do not use:  Focus — use color/border/focus
Use instead: color/border/focus
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

radius.$description:
Intent:      Corner radius of the chat composer — larger than a single-line input
Use when:    PromptInput container
Do not use:  Single-line inputs — use radius/control
Use instead: radius/control
Note:        Added 2026-09-22 for the AI chat panel (AI Elements, VS Code-style).
Status:      active

canvas.$description:
Intent:      Background of the Career Map canvas
Use when:    Filling the pannable canvas behind CareerMap nodes and connections
Do not use:  Page backgrounds, cards, panels or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: color/background/default for pages, color/background/app for the app shell
Status:      active

grid.$description:
Intent:      Dot grid on the Career Map canvas
Use when:    Drawing the background dot pattern in CareerMap
Do not use:  Borders, dividers or any line outside the Career Map canvas
Use instead: color/border/subtle for general hairline separators
Status:      active

node-surface.$description:
Intent:      Fill of one role card on the Career Map
Use when:    Filling a CareerMapNode
Do not use:  General cards or rows outside Career Map
Use instead: color/surface/default for generic flat cards
Foreground:  career-map/node-foreground
Status:      active

node-border.$description:
Intent:      Resting border of a role card on the Career Map
Use when:    Outlining a CareerMapNode that is a company-path, current or planned role
Do not use:  Career vision cards, the Active target card, selected or focused cards
Use instead: career-map/vision-border, career-map/target-border, career-map/node-selected
Status:      active

node-foreground.$description:
Intent:      Position name inside a Career Map role card
Use when:    Rendering the Position title in a CareerMapNode
Do not use:  Level text, state labels or text outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-description for the level, the state label tokens for labels
Status:      active

node-description.$description:
Intent:      Supporting text inside a Career Map role card
Use when:    Rendering the level ("L2 · Mid") and neutral state labels (Planned, Career vision) in a CareerMapNode
Do not use:  Position titles, current or target labels, text outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-foreground for titles, career-map/current-label and career-map/target-label
Status:      active

node-selected.$description:
Intent:      Ring around the selected or keyboard-focused role card on the Career Map
Use when:    The CareerMapNode whose details are open, and :focus-visible on any node
Do not use:  Resting, current or target states
Use instead: career-map/node-border, career-map/target-border
Status:      active

current-label.$description:
Intent:      "You are here" label and icon on the employee's current role card
Use when:    The state label of the CareerMapNode in state current
Do not use:  Other labels, links or any text outside Career Map
Use instead: color/text/link for links, career-map/node-description for neutral labels
Status:      active

target-label.$description:
Intent:      "Active target" label and icon on the target role card
Use when:    The state label of the CareerMapNode in state target
Do not use:  Success messages or any text outside Career Map
Use instead: color/text/success for general success text
Status:      active

target-border.$description:
Intent:      Border of the Active target role card — a non-colour-text signal for the target
Use when:    Outlining the CareerMapNode in state target
Do not use:  Validation borders or containers outside Career Map
Use instead: color/border/success for validated inputs
Status:      active

band-completed.$description:
Intent:      Status band across the top of a Career Map card in state completed
Use when:    Filling the band that holds the state label (icon + text) of a CareerMapNode in state completed
Do not use:  Card bodies, badges, alerts or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-surface for the card body
Foreground:  career-map/node-description (6.9:1)
Status:      active

band-current.$description:
Intent:      Status band across the top of a Career Map card in state current
Use when:    Filling the band that holds the state label (icon + text) of a CareerMapNode in state current
Do not use:  Card bodies, badges, alerts or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-surface for the card body
Foreground:  career-map/current-label (4.8:1)
Status:      active

band-target.$description:
Intent:      Status band across the top of a Career Map card in state target
Use when:    Filling the band that holds the state label (icon + text) of a CareerMapNode in state target
Do not use:  Card bodies, badges, alerts or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-surface for the card body
Foreground:  career-map/target-label (4.6:1)
Status:      active

band-planned.$description:
Intent:      Status band across the top of a Career Map card in state planned
Use when:    Filling the band that holds the state label (icon + text) of a CareerMapNode in state planned
Do not use:  Card bodies, badges, alerts or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-surface for the card body
Foreground:  career-map/node-description (7.2:1)
Status:      active

band-vision.$description:
Intent:      Status band across the top of a Career Map card in state vision
Use when:    Filling the band that holds the state label (icon + text) of a CareerMapNode in state vision
Do not use:  Card bodies, badges, alerts or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-surface for the card body
Foreground:  career-map/node-description (7.0:1)
Status:      active

vision-border.$description:
Intent:      Dashed border of a Career vision card — the employee's own draft path, not a company path
Use when:    Outlining a CareerMapNode in state vision (dashed)
Do not use:  Company-path cards, dividers or borders outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/node-border for company-path cards
Status:      active

vision-edge.$description:
Intent:      Dashed line of a Career vision, and the ring on its cards when the vision is highlighted
Use when:    Drawing links on a vision route in CareerMap; ringing that route's cards when it's selected
Do not use:  Company-path lines, the card selection ring, or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/followed-edge or career-map/other-path-edge for company paths, career-map/node-selected for a selected card
Status:      active

vision-edge-inactive.$description:
Intent:      Dashed line and legend swatch of a Career vision that isn't the active route — lighter so the active route reads darker
Use when:    A vision route while another route is selected (or nothing is selected and the followed path is active)
Do not use:  Text, card borders or anything outside Career Map lines and swatches
Use instead: career-map/vision-edge when the vision is the active route
Status:      active

followed-edge.$description:
Intent:      Line of the company path the employee follows (their main route), and the ring on its cards when that path is highlighted
Use when:    Drawing links on the route marked followed in CareerMap
Do not use:  Other company paths, success messages, or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/other-path-edge for other company paths, color/border/success for validation
Status:      active

followed-edge-inactive.$description:
Intent:      Line and legend swatch of the followed company path while another route is selected — still green (it's your path), just lighter
Use when:    The followed route in CareerMap when a different route is selected
Do not use:  Text, success states or anything outside Career Map lines and swatches
Use instead: career-map/followed-edge when the followed path is active (selected, or nothing selected)
Status:      active

other-path-edge.$description:
Intent:      Line, arrow and route ring of any company path the employee doesn't follow, when it's the selected route. Colour means the path's role, not its identity — all other paths share it; the legend names them
Use when:    A selected non-followed company path in CareerMap
Do not use:  The followed path (green), Career visions (violet), text or anything outside Career Map
Use instead: career-map/followed-edge, career-map/vision-edge, career-map/other-path-edge-inactive when not selected
Status:      active

other-path-edge-inactive.$description:
Intent:      Line and legend swatch of a non-followed company path that isn't selected
Use when:    Resting state of every company path the employee doesn't follow
Do not use:  Text, borders or anything outside Career Map lines and swatches
Use instead: career-map/other-path-edge when the path is selected
Status:      active

node-radius.$description:
Intent:      Corner radius of a Career Map role card
Use when:    Rounding a CareerMapNode
Do not use:  Controls or containers outside Career Map
Use instead: radius/surface for generic cards
Status:      active

node-padding.$description:
Intent:      Inset inside a Career Map role card
Use when:    Padding a CareerMapNode
Do not use:  Page layout or containers outside Career Map
Use instead: spacing/component/md for generic component padding
Status:      active

node-gap.$description:
Intent:      Vertical separation between label, title and level inside a Career Map role card
Use when:    Stacking the text lines of a CareerMapNode
Do not use:  Spacing between cards or outside Career Map
Use instead: spacing/component/xs for generic tight stacks
Status:      active
